params.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic commercial, warm tungsten barbershop at night, shallow depth of field, multi-shot. Identity lock: it is the same woman in every shot, with exactly the face of image 1 (same eyes, nose, lips, face shape, skin and makeup). The face never changes; only the hair changes. Shot 1 (0–2s): extreme macro slide along the bevelled metal edge of a tall portrait smart mirror on a round metal base; a thin line of white light runs down the edge; blurred warm bulbs in the glass. Shot 2 (2–4s): low wide shot, the young woman from image 1 (long layered chestnut-brown waves, white lace camisole, thin gold chain choker) walks in and stops in front of the mirror, tucks a strand of hair behind her ear. Shot 3 (4–6s): over-the-shoulder onto the mirror; the glass softly lights up with a grid of hair-colour swatch cards glowing behind her reflection; her fingertip taps one card. Shot 4 (6–10s): frontal close-up of her reflection only; a vertical line of light sweeps left to right across the reflection and her hair in the mirror becomes exactly the milky lilac-purple of image 2, while she glances down at her real brown hair and smiles; then another sweep and the reflection shows exactly the airy ash-blonde cut of image 3. Only these two looks. Shot 5 (10–12s): the camera pushes into the mirror and passes through the glass with a soft ripple; the shop door behind her opens and golden sunlight floods the frame. Photoreal, 24fps film look.
